title: ColorSplash
shortDescription: A simple and easy to use API for generating images of a certain color.
description: ColorSplash is a REST API that allows users to generate images of a specific color. Built with Python and Flask, it provides a simple interface for creating and manipulating images. The API supports various image formats and can be easily integrated into other applications.
